verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm that Fly.io has a status page, including an org-level view (comm-3, comm-6). However, the same users say it showed green or 'no incidents' during real outages. The only incident explanation in the pack is an ad-hoc staff reply on Hacker News (comm-9), not a published postmortem archive. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a public status page, a historical incident and postmortem archive, and evidence that the page reliably reflects outages.
